translation.受控原始文本；多个值使用批量编辑查看和修改。: Controlled raw text; view and edit multiple items in the batch editor.
translation.输入、清空和确认时回传文本与当前规则解析后的列表。: Reports the text and parsed items when typing, clearing or applying edits.
translation.批量确认可异步校验；返回 false 保留草稿，异常显示可重试提示。: Validate batch edits asynchronously; false retains the draft, while errors display a retry hint.
translation.显示批量编辑入口，可在浮层中粘贴多行文本。: Displays the batch editor action for pasting multiple lines in a popover.
translation.开启后空白字符也作为分隔符，默认保留词组内部空格。: When enabled, whitespace also separates items; spaces within phrases are preserved by default.
translation.开启后同时接受英文逗号和中文逗号。: When enabled, accepts both English and Chinese commas.
translation.覆盖批量编辑按钮、提示与统计文案语言。: Overrides the locale for batch editor actions, hints and counts.
translation.按中文 key 覆写批量编辑文案。: Overrides batch editor messages using their Chinese source keys.
translation.取消、点击外部或 Escape 关闭草稿编辑时回调。: Called when cancelling, clicking outside or pressing Escape to dismiss the draft editor.
translation.批量编辑浮层打开或关闭后通知调用方。: Notifies the caller when the batch editor opens or closes.
translation.设置编辑浮层宽度，自动约束到视口可用空间。: Sets the editor width, constrained to the available viewport.
translation.覆写草稿文本域的行数、长度限制、占位和样式。: Overrides the draft textarea rows, length limit, placeholder and styles.
translation.分别覆写输入控件与浮层区域样式。: Overrides styles for individual input and editor slots.
translation.默认与筛选控件保持相同的小尺寸。: Uses the same compact size as filter controls by default.
translation.允许清空已提交的文本，草稿内清空需确认才提交。: Allows clearing the committed text; clearing a draft requires Apply to commit.
translation.单行和批量按每项应用字符过滤，保留已开启的分隔符。: Direct and batch input share per-item character filtering and preserve enabled separators.
translation.单行和批量按每项应用增量正则过滤，保留已开启的分隔符。: Direct and batch input share per-item incremental pattern filtering and preserve enabled separators.
translation.按换行和回车切分，去掉首尾空白与空项；可分别开启空白分隔和中英文逗号分隔，保留顺: Splits on line breaks and carriage returns, trims items and removes empty items; optional whitespace and comma separators preserve order and duplicates.
translation.控制自动轨道的最小宽度；最多六列，非法值回退 170，操作区保留最后一个显式轨道: Sets the minimum automatic track width, up to six columns; invalid values fall back to 170. Actions occupy the last explicit track.
translation.PageFilter.Item 字段；主区域按容器宽度计算等分 Grid 列数，: PageFilter.Item fields share equal explicit grid tracks with actions. Fields beyond maxRows move into a Drawer using the same controlled state.
translation.列宽手柄全部关闭；前 3 条记录可用指针调整行高，范围为 40 - 88px，也: Column handles are off. Use the pointer to resize the first three rows from 40–88px, or focus a handle and use the arrow keys, Home or End.
translation.启用行底部行高调整手柄；可按记录限制，并支持指针拖动和键盘方向键、Home/En: Enables row-height handles at row boundaries, can be limited by record, and supports pointer and arrow/Home/End keyboard resizing.
translation.fillRemainingSpace=false：保留精确内容总宽，每列独立调整: fillRemainingSpace=false: preserve the exact content width and resize each column independently; releasing the pointer or resizing the container does not fill remaining space.
translation.调整最近更新列后改变窗口宽度：组件继续优先保留该列的提交宽度，其余普通列负责填充: Resize the Last updated column, then resize the window: its committed width keeps priority while other ordinary columns provide the fill.
translation.控制是否填充剩余空间；true 在松手后优先保留目标列宽，其他普通列持续填满余量: Controls remaining-space fill. With true, preserve the target width on release and keep filling other ordinary columns as needed, even beyond maxWidth. Fixed, action and auxiliary columns are excluded. False keeps the exact content width and resizes independently.
translation.直接拖动列宽时允许的最大像素宽度；自动填充为避免表格尾部留白可以超过此值。: Limits direct column resizing; automatic fill may exceed this value to keep the table full width.
translation.指定普通列优先吸收余量；是否填充由 fillRemainingSpace 控制。: Prioritizes an ordinary column for remaining space; fillRemainingSpace controls whether to fill. false or scroll.x=max-content always preserves exact content width and independent resizing.
translation.使用统一操作列宽度：桌面为 180px，视口小于 500px 时为 60px；操: Action columns use 180px on desktop and 60px below a 500px viewport. They never absorb spare width or compensate for other column resizes.
translation.在表头标题旁显示说明图标，通过公共 Tooltip 展示内容并与标题垂直居中。: Displays a help icon beside the header title using the shared Tooltip, centered vertically with the title.
translation.固定列隔离与多级表头: Fixed column isolation and grouped headers
translation.名称和操作列保持固定宽度，选择与展开列也不参与补偿；拖动普通列或末列验证边界。: Name, actions, selection and expansion widths remain protected. Resize ordinary and last columns to verify the bounds.
translation.固定列不会被普通列拖动或自动填充改变宽度。: Ordinary column resizes and automatic filling never change fixed column widths.
translation.是否把主区可见字段也放入 Drawer；设为 false 时仅展示已折叠字段及: Includes visible inline fields in the Drawer; false shows only collapsed fields and moreFields, all sharing the same controlled state.
translation.折叠时主筛选区行数上限，有限值归一化到 1..2；autoCollapse=fa: Limits collapsed inline rows to a normalized value of 1..2; autoCollapse=false lets fields expand into additional natural rows.
translation.按字段数量、容器和动作宽度判断溢出并提供 Drawer；false 时完整展开，: Detects overflow from field count, container and action widths and provides a Drawer; false shows all fields, and widening the window never unmounts an open Drawer.
translation.fillRemainingSpace=true：拖动末列时只改变目标列；松手后目: fillRemainingSpace=true: dragging the final ordinary column changes only that column. On release, its width stays exact while other ordinary columns fill remaining space, even beyond maxWidth when needed; fixed and action columns stay unchanged.
translation.在浮动 label 文本后显示说明图标；文本 span、Tooltip 包装和: Shows a help icon after the floating label. The text span, Tooltip wrappers and SVG share the same vertical center; hover or focus reveals the hint.
translation.追加到 item 根 div 节点，保留 biu-pro-page-filter: Appends a class to the root item div and retains the biu-pro-page-filter__item class.
translation.设置主输入错误状态；批量提交失败保留独立重试提示。: Sets the main input error state; failed batch submissions retain a separate retry message.
translation.显示加载并禁止输入、清空和打开批量编辑。: Shows loading and blocks typing, clearing and opening batch editing.
translation.清空已提交值时回调；草稿内清空需应用后才提交。: Runs when the committed value is cleared. Clearing a draft commits only after Apply.
translation.显示主输入字符计数；编辑浮层另外显示解析后的项数。: Shows the main input character count. The editor separately shows the parsed item count.
translation.在主输入左侧显示前置内容。: Shows leading content before the main input.
translation.在主输入右侧显示自定义内容，并与批量入口组合。: Shows custom trailing content beside the batch entry.
translation.透传主输入属性；顶层值缺省时使用其 value/defaultValue，批量草: Forwards main input attributes. value/defaultValue provide fallbacks when top-level values are omitted; ProTextField still owns batch drafts.
translation.追加到 ProTextField 根节点；PageFilter.Item 自动追: Appends a class to the ProTextField root. PageFilter.Item automatically adds w-full.
translation.禁止输入、清空及批量编辑，并关闭已打开的编辑浮层。: Blocks typing, clearing and batch editing, and closes an open editor.
translation.保留文本可读，禁止输入、清空及批量编辑。: Keeps text readable while blocking typing, clearing and batch editing.
translation.主输入占位文案；草稿占位由 textareaProps.placeholder: Main input placeholder. textareaProps.placeholder overrides the draft placeholder.
translation.限制主输入长度，草稿默认继承，可由 textareaProps.maxLengt: Limits the main input length. Drafts inherit the limit unless textareaProps.maxLength overrides it.
translation.主输入粘贴前回调；preventDefault 可阻止多行粘贴自动打开草稿。: Runs before main input paste processing. preventDefault blocks automatic draft opening for multiline paste.
translation.主输入按键回调，Enter 可打开多行汇总；草稿内 Ctrl/Command+E: Main input keyboard callback. Enter opens a multiline summary; Ctrl/Command+Enter applies an editor draft.
translation.主输入点击回调；未 preventDefault 时点击多行汇总打开原文编辑。: Main input click callback. Clicking a multiline summary opens raw-text editing unless preventDefault is called.
translation.观察主输入原生 input 事件；值同步使用 onChange(value, i: Observes native main input events. Synchronize values through onChange(value, items).
translation.转发到主输入，支持聚焦和读取选择范围。: Forwarded to the main input for focus and selection access.
translation.仅解析输入，不修改原文；空字符串、纯空白和运行时非字符串值返回空列表。: Parses without modifying the source. Empty, whitespace-only and runtime non-string input returns an empty list.
translation.开启后所有空白字符参与分隔，默认保留词组内部空格。: Includes every whitespace character in separators when enabled; phrases retain internal spaces by default.
translation.独立开启中英文逗号分隔，可与空白分隔组合。: Independently enables Chinese and English comma separators and can be combined with whitespace splitting.
translation.只为显式开启的叶子列显示手柄；fixed 列通过面向普通列的内边调整自身，其他列: Only explicitly resizable leaf columns show a handle. Fixed columns resize themselves from the inner edge facing ordinary columns; resizing other columns and filling remaining space do not change their width.
translation.固定右侧操作列已开启独立调整：拖动靠近普通列的左侧内边，宽度范围为 80–260: The fixed-right action column supports independent resizing from its left inner edge, facing ordinary columns, within 80–260px. Resizing other columns and automatic fill do not change its width.
translation.固定列只有显式 resizable=true 时可以直接调整自身宽度；左右固定列: A fixed column can resize itself only when resizable=true is explicitly set. Both fixed sides use their inner edge facing ordinary columns.
translation.普通输入即时回传原文及解析列表；失焦时按已开启分隔符拆分并格式化；批量应用回传换: Direct typing reports raw text and parsed items. Blur splits and formats enabled separators; batch Apply reports newline-normalized text.
translation.主输入失焦先通知调用方，再按已开启分隔符拆分并格式化；文本变化时通过 onCha: Calls blur handlers first, then splits and formats enabled separators; changed text is reported through onChange(value, items).
translation.显示24px批量编辑入口，可在浮层中粘贴多行文本。: Shows a 24px batch editor entry for pasting multiline text into the popover.
translation.显示24px批量编辑入口，可在浮层中粘贴多行文本；关闭入口后，失焦分隔仍生效。: Shows the 24px batch editor entry for multiline paste; blur splitting stays enabled if the entry is hidden.
translation.页码、页大小、快速跳转、总数、三档响应式布局和简洁模式。: Page navigation, page size, quick jump, totals, three responsive layouts, and simple mode.
translation.自定义页码、总数、页大小选项和三档响应式布局。: Custom page items, totals, page-size options, and three responsive layouts.
translation.同时设置页大小下拉和快速跳转输入框宽度；默认 90px。responsive 小: Sets the page-size select and quick-jump input width together; defaults to 90px. With responsive enabled, both use 45px below 800px. Below 560px only the current page is shown; from 560–799px the full page list remains while range/total text is hidden; at 800px and wider this configured width is used.
translation.小于 560px 时只显示当前页；560–799px 保留完整页码但隐藏范围/总: Below 560px, show only the current page. From 560–799px, keep the full page list and hide range/total text. At 800px and wider, use the standard layout. Page-size and quick-jump controls are 45px below 800px.
translation.支持数字像素值或 CSS 宽度字符串；同时设置 Table 分页的页大小下拉和跳: Accepts a pixel number or CSS width string and sets the Table page-size select and quick-jump input widths together. Defaults to 90px; responsive layouts use 45px below 800px.
translation.响应式分为三档：小于 560px 显示当前页，560–799px 隐藏范围/总数: Responsive behavior has three bands: below 560px, show only the current page; from 560–799px, hide range/total text and keep the full page list; at 800px and wider, use the standard layout. The page-size and quick-jump controls are 45px in the first two bands.
translation.标记操作列；列不参与余量分配或其他列的拖动补偿。宽度按表格可用宽度响应式设置为: Marks an action column excluded from remaining-space distribution and resize compensation. Its width follows the available table width: 60/160/190px below 560px, from 560–799px, and at 800px or wider. The default ButtonList maxCount is 1/3/5 across those bands, including the overflow button. Explicit column widths and ButtonList limits take precedence; resizing still requires resizable.
translation.最多可见槽位，包含 ellipsis 溢出按钮；达到上限时最后一格自动作为 Dr: Maximum visible slots including the ellipsis overflow button; the last slot becomes a DropdownMenu when the limit is reached. An explicit maxCount applies at every viewport.
translation.指定 800px 以下的可见槽位上限，优先于 maxCount 和响应式默认；未: Sets the visible-slot limit below 800px, taking precedence over maxCount and responsive defaults. Without explicit limits, standalone lists default to 3 slots below 800px and 1 below 560px; action columns receive their responsive default from Table.
